investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Nimbrook Studios (online gaming); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.45.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster nimbro-prod-uswest (EKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic chat-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer chat-svc, consumer telemetry-ingest; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
